name: Supabase Client Integration
description: Add lightweight Supabase REST client (no SDK dependency) with company-scoped data access. Provides typed wrappers for heartbeat_runs, memories, budget_policies, budget_incidents, activity_log, hive_mind tables. Supports both local SQLite (existing) and remote Supabase (new) as dual-write targets.

name: Budget Governance System
description: Per-agent budget policies with configurable windows (daily/monthly/lifetime). Warning thresholds (default 80%), hard-stop enforcement (auto-pause agent), incident logging. Checks budget before each agent run. Integrates with existing token_usage tracking in db.ts.

name: Heartbeat Execution Model
description: Track every agent execution as a heartbeat_run record: invocation source, status lifecycle (queued/running/completed/failed), tokens used, cost, duration, exit code, session state before/after. Wraps existing runAgent() to create/update heartbeat records. Enables dead agent detection.

name: Activity Audit Log
description: Immutable audit trail for all agent mutations. Every significant action writes to activity_log: actor (user/agent), action_type, entity_type, entity_id, detail JSONB, timestamp. Extends existing audit_log in db.ts with richer structure. Dashboard-queryable.

name: Enhanced Web Dashboard
description: Major upgrade to dashboard.ts API layer. New endpoints: heartbeat runs/stats, budget policies/incidents/pause/resume, activity feed, session health, plugin status, Discord/Supabase status. Health endpoint at /health.

name: Discord Adapter
description: REST API-based Discord adapter (no discord.js dependency) for sending/receiving messages. Supports: channel listing, message reading, message sending, webhook posting, rich embed posting. Alert helpers for health, budget, and task notifications.

name: Plugin System
description: Lightweight plugin architecture. Plugin manifest (plugin.yaml/json) declares: id, name, version, capabilities, tools, event subscriptions. Plugin loader discovers plugins in plugins/ directory. Plugins can: register tools for agent execution, subscribe to events, provide dashboard widgets. In-process TypeScript modules with YAML manifests.

name: Enhanced Setup Wizard
description: Extended setup wizard with new sections for Supabase cloud sync, budget governance defaults, and Discord notification configuration. Tests Supabase connection, validates webhook URLs.

name: Health Check & Monitoring
description: GET /health endpoint returning JSON status of all subsystems: database, Telegram bot, Supabase connection, memory system, scheduler. Periodic self-check (5-min interval) with status change logging. Registration pattern for DB access.

name: Memory System Upgrade
description: Session compaction tracking (max 200 runs / 2M tokens / 72h thresholds from Paperclip). Per-agent session state with rotation and audit logging. Registration pattern for DB session clearing.
